patches.name: BYOK without Copilot entitlement
patches.reason: Allow independently configured BYOK custom endpoints when signed into GitHub without a Copilot entitlement.

patches.name: Keep built-in chat extension enabled for BYOK setup
patches.reason: Prevent fresh profiles built from the upstream Visual Studio Code source from disabling the bundled GitHub.copilot-chat extension before the BYOK endpoint-management UI can be used.

patches.name: Preserve Copilot SDK entrypoint for source builds
patches.reason: Keep @github/copilot/sdk/index.js in the packaged extension so the bundled Copilot Chat extension can activate in local source builds.

patches.name: Keep BYOK model management reachable during setup
patches.reason: Expose Manage Models even while Copilot setup is required, so first-run BYOK users have a path to add custom endpoints.

patches.name: Identify build as Sprouted Code
patches.reason: Apply minimal product identity fields so the build presents itself as Sprouted Code while remaining close to the upstream Visual Studio Code source.

patches.name: Use product name in welcome onboarding
patches.reason: Make the first-launch onboarding welcome title follow product.json, so Sprouted Code does not greet users as VS Code.

patches.name: Only patch Windows PE dependencies
patches.reason: Prevent Windows source packaging from passing bundled Linux and macOS native modules to signtool and rcedit.

patches.name: Use a cross-platform build test glob
patches.reason: Allow the build package test command to discover its Node test files on Windows as well as POSIX shells.

patches.name: Enable the Microsoft extension marketplace
patches.reason: Allow public test builds to exercise compatibility with extensions distributed through the Microsoft marketplace.

patches.name: Make extension signature verification product-configurable
patches.reason: Let source-built products explicitly disable unavailable Microsoft signature verification while preserving the upstream default.
